foci.d: Alfred Neumann fought in the International Brigades. With the old KPD men and the Spain veterans he takes the state back from the managers and the consumers.

e: The Party State: Ideology drift defence +5 %
foci.d: Every party member who praised Prague, the market or Western television is called before the control commission.
foci.o: Choice hub: whose hard line.

e: The Planned Economy: Fuel gain +5 %, Energy use -3 %
The Party State: Foreign influence defence -5 %
foci.d: Back to the fold: every instruction from the Soviet embassy is obeyed, every Soviet adviser welcome - and Soviet oil flows at friendship prices. Moscow likes what it sees.
foci.o: Cheap Soviet oil and arms; the embassy's men sit in every ministry (foreign influence defence).

e: Adds the Cold War idea "Self-Reliance" for 365 days
Programme "The Legacy of Ernst Thälmann": Sanction resistance (Imperia) +5 %
foci.d: Bucharest and Tirana show the way: a hard line needs no master - and Brezhnev's détente is revisionism too.
foci.o: Ceaușescu/Hoxha style: self-reliance; Moscow's Trust falls hard.

e: Offer to SOV (they decide; no advance reward): Soviet advisers in every ministry and Kombinat; if Moscow accepts: research +3 % and factory efficiency growth +3 % for us, Moscow's Trust +5
The Planned Economy: Licence production speed +5 %
foci.d: A Soviet adviser in every ministry and every Kombinat, as in 1950 - the Guard asks for them.

e: The Planned Economy: Infrastructure construction +5 %, Consumer goods +3 %
foci.d: No Western machines and no Soviet favours: the republic builds its own plants with its own hands, whatever the shops lack.

e: The Economic Line becomes "Socialism Without Debts": Sanction resistance (Imperia) +5 %, Military factory productivity +3 %, Interest rates -5 %, Consumer goods +5 %
foci.d: Not one Deutschmark of debt: what the republic cannot pay for, it does without. The Guard's economic line is the one of 1950 - heavy industry, sacrifice and no masters.
foci.o: The Guard's economic identity (Economic Line). Price inside the idea: consumer goods. Choice hub: who pays for the fortress.

e: The Planned Economy: Civilian industry tax +3 %, Consumer goods +2 %
foci.d: The private bakers, tailors and carpenters who survived 1972 join the cooperatives - or close their doors. Their workshops and their savings go to the state.
foci.o: The craftsmen pay (faction) and the shops lose their repair men and bakers (consumer goods).

e: The Planned Economy: Military factory productivity +3 %, Civilian factory construction +5 %, Consumer goods +3 %
foci.d: Steel from Eisenhüttenstadt, machines from Magdeburg: the 'first socialist city' sets the pace again, as in 1952 - and the consumers wait, as in 1952.
foci.o: The consumers pay (consumer goods +3 %).

e: The Economic Line becomes "War Communism": Sanction resistance (Imperia) +10 %, Military factory productivity +5 %, Interest rates -5 %, Military factory construction +5 %, Consumer goods +7 %
Adds "The Fortress of Socialism": Ideology drift defence +10 %, Stability +3 %, Trade opinion -10 %
The National People's Army: Defence on core territory +5 %
foci.d: Closed, armed and pure: the republic as the fortress of the working class on the front line of the Cold War.
foci.o: Capstone: upgrades "Socialism Without Debts" (no PP). Price: consumer goods +7 %, trade opinion -10 %.

e: The Party State: Ideological defence (Cold War) +5 %
foci.d: Statues, films and pioneer oaths: the KPD leader murdered in Buchenwald in 1944 becomes the patron saint of the republic.
foci.o: Choice hub: mobilise for what.

e: The National People's Army: Recruitable population +3 %, Mobilisation speed +5 %
foci.d: Combat groups in every factory, pre-military training in every school, the reserves called up every year.
foci.o: Price: the reservists are missing in the factories (workforce).

e: The Planned Economy: Workforce +3 %, Infrastructure construction +5 %
foci.d: Voluntary Saturday shifts, the National Reconstruction Programme, brigades of socialist labour - sweat instead of credits.
foci.o: Price: the 'voluntary' Saturdays wear people out (stability).

foci.d: Erich Mielke, Minister for State Security since 1957, no longer protects the party - he replaces it. Forty-three thousand officers are now the government.

e: Shield and Sword: Decryption +5 %, Civilian intel +5 %
foci.d: No arrests, no martyrs: careers broken, marriages poisoned, rumours planted - the quiet method of Directive 1/76, years early - carried out by unofficial collaborators in every brigade, every house community and every parish council.
foci.o: Choice hub: the method of rule.

e: Adds "Silent Repression": Stability +3 %, Ideology drift defence +10 %, Police costs +10 %
foci.d: The method of the 1970s: sign Helsinki, smile at the West - and decompose the enemies of the state in silence. The Ministry's own law college at Potsdam-Eiche trains its officers in 'operative psychology'.
foci.o: Price inside the idea: police costs.

e: Adds "Open Terror": Stability +5 %, Ideology drift defence +15 %, Political power gain +5 %, Trade opinion -20 %, Research speed -5 %
Event: The World Condemns: Western capitals recall their ambassadors and freeze talks, the Non-Aligned protest; each country decides its own reaction through the event
foci.d: The method of 1950: show trials, death sentences, mass arrests. Fear works faster than decomposition - and the whole world watches.
foci.o: Drastic: trade and research collapse, the republic is isolated.

e: Shield and Sword of the Party popularity +5 %
foci.d: Former Politburo members confess on television to spying for Bonn. Nobody believes it, and everybody understands it.

e: Adds "The Total Surveillance State": Stability +3 %, Ideology drift defence +5 %, Police costs +15 %, Research speed -3 %
Shield and Sword: Civilian intel +5 %, Enemy operative capture chance +5 %
foci.d: A file on every citizen, a microphone in every office, a smell sample in every jar: the state knows everything about everyone.
foci.o: Political capstone (no PP).

foci.d: The Ministry's own army, quartered in Berlin-Adlershof, guards the government quarter - and now the Minister's state.
foci.o: Choice hub: what becomes of the SED.

foci.d: The SED keeps its congresses, its banners and its First Secretary - all of them reporting to the Ministry.
foci.o: Calm and Moscow's approval; the Ministry has to share its power with the apparatus (MfS opinion).

e: Adds "Rule by Decree": Political power gain +5 %, Bureaucracy costs -10 %, Stability -3 %
foci.d: Two million party members are no longer needed: the apparatus is dissolved and its files move to the Ministry's archive.
foci.o: Political side: the Ministry takes all power (the tree's second PP); the Nomenklatura and Moscow object.

e: Shield and Sword: Intel network gain +10 %, Foreign subversive activities +5 %
Offer to SYE, SYR (they decide; no advance reward): MfS advisers build up the state security services of Aden and Damascus; if accepted: opinion +25 on both sides and intel network gain +5 % for us
foci.d: Markus Wolf's foreign intelligence - the 'man without a face' - runs agents in Bonn, at NATO and in every West German party.

foci.b: `has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_mfs_sector_science_and_technology` (the MfS technology sector - no double reward)
e: The Planned Economy: Licence production speed +5 %
foci.d: The foreign intelligence's science sector steals what the COCOM lists will not sell: computer circuits, machine tools, chemical formulas.

e: Shield and Sword: Decryption +5 %, Army intel +5 %
foci.d: Günter Guillaume, an officer of Main Directorate A, works in the Chancellor's office in Bonn. Every paper on Ostpolitik crosses Mielke's desk.
foci.o: Guillaume became Brandt's aide in 1972 and was exposed in 1974; Brandt resigned over it.

e: The Economic Line becomes "The Chekist Economy": Civilian industry tax +3 %, Sanction resistance (Imperia) +10 %, Police costs +10 %, Corruption costs +5 %
foci.d: The Ministry already owns firms, guest houses and Schalck's trading empire; its prisons make furniture, tights and camera parts for Western mail-order houses. Mielke makes it the economic line: every enterprise has an officer, every officer a quota.
foci.o: The Ministry's economic identity (Economic Line). Price inside the idea: police and corruption costs. Choice hub: money or control.

e: Programme "The Chekist Order": Civilian industry tax +2 %
Unlocks decisions: Prison labour contracts: Western mail-order houses buy goods made in Bautzen and Hoheneck (Hard Currency category)
The Party State: Foreign influence defence -5 %
foci.d: Bonn pays forty thousand marks a head for political prisoners, IKEA and Quelle buy what Bautzen and Hoheneck produce. The Ministry sells its prisoners twice - their labour and their freedom.
foci.o: Hard currency; the deals with the West open doors the Ministry would rather keep shut (foreign influence defence).

e: Shield and Sword: Civilian intel +5 %, Police costs +5 %
foci.d: No deals with the class enemy: every prisoner stays, every enterprise gets an MfS liaison officer, and every delivery gap is investigated as sabotage.
foci.o: Control and order; an officer in every enterprise costs money (police costs).

e: The Economic Line becomes "The Ministry's Kombinat": Civilian industry tax +5 %, Sanction resistance (Imperia) +10 %, Civilian factory output +3 %, Police costs +10 %, Corruption costs +8 %
foci.d: The Ministry for State Security becomes the republic's largest enterprise: construction firms, workshops, trading houses and a headquarters in Normannenstraße that grows by a block every year.
foci.o: Capstone: upgrades "The Chekist Economy" (no PP).

e: Programme "The Founder's Course": Political power gain +5 %, Research speed +2 %
Our leader gains the trait "Founder of the Republic"
foci.d: Walter Ulbricht has led the party since 1950 and the state since 1960. At seventy-six he still writes the economic theses himself - and still believes the republic can overtake West Germany.
foci.o: Open from 1 January 1970: the init sets `COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_ulb`. His historical death (1 August 1973) is an event in the concept.

foci.d: Erich Honecker, secretary for security and cadres since 1958, remains the party's second man. Moscow approves, the apparatus runs smoothly - and Ulbricht's pupil gains a little more of it every month, while the reform economists lose their patron.

e: The Party State: Foreign influence defence +5 %
Honecker loses the cadre department (`COLDWAR_DDR_ulb_team_verner`): his candidacy needs SED Nomenklatura opinion 10 higher
foci.d: Alt-history: Ulbricht moves the cadre department from Honecker to Paul Verner, the Berlin district chief who owes him his career. The crown prince loses his network overnight, the apparatus answers to the founder rather than to Karlshorst - and the Soviet embassy takes note.
foci.o: Alt-hist. The priced PP side of the tree (Moscow's Trust -3). The flag is a hook for the Central Committee candidacy of Honecker.

e: Programme "The Founder's Course": Max factory efficiency +2 %
foci.d: Ulbricht's own think tank in the Politburo: Günter Mittag, the economist Wolfgang Berger and the young planners write the theses, and the apparatus is told afterwards.

e: The Party State: Ideological defence (Cold War) +5 %
foci.d: Ulbricht's formula of 1967: the classes are no longer enemies; workers, farmers, the intelligentsia and even the churchgoers form one community under the party. Since the Bitterfeld conferences writers go into the factories and workers write - 'Pick up the pen, mate!'

The 1965 law on the unified socialist education system: ten years of polytechnic school for every child, one day a week in a factory. Its first full generation enters the workforce in 1970 - skilled workers, not slogans.

foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Walter Ulbricht is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_ulb`); date from 01.01.1973
foci.b: `has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_soc_the_festival_generation` (the X World Festival - no double reward)
e: The Socialist Camp: Assistance effectiveness (Cold War) +5 %
foci.d: Summer 1973: 25,000 guests from 140 countries and eight million visitors turn East Berlin into a 'Red Woodstock'. For nine days the republic looks young, open and confident - and the solidarity with Vietnam and Chile is real.
foci.o: Historically Ulbricht died on 1 August 1973, in the middle of the festival: only a fast player or "The Kremlin Doctors" reaches it.

e: The Economic Line becomes "The Economic System of Socialism": Civilian factory productivity +4 %, Max factory efficiency +3 %, Research speed +2 %, Consumer goods +3 %, Stability -2 %
foci.d: The New Economic System of 1963 grown up (ÖSS, 1967-70): the Kombinate become accounting units, prices and profit become levers, and science is declared a direct productive force - the Academy reform of 1968 ties the institutes to the plan.
foci.o: Doctrine entry: replaces whichever economic line is active (at the start "Overtaking Without Catching Up").

foci.d: Alt-history: Ulbricht deepens the reform instead of the prestige list. Enterprises keep part of their profit and set part of their prices; the Kombinat directors become managers. Moscow and the apparatus smell market socialism.
foci.o: Model fork A1: efficiency and tax income, decentralised; price: stability -3 % in the doctrine, Western drift, Moscow's Trust -3.

e: The Economic Line becomes "The Structure-Determining Tasks": Civilian factory output +5 %, Civilian factory construction +10 %, synthetic_refinery_productivity_modifier +5 %, Consumer goods +5 %
foci.d: 1968-70: petrochemistry at Schwedt and Leuna II, electronics, machine tools and automation get every brick and every Mark first - the hard winter of 1969/70 empties the shops.
foci.o: Model fork A2 (historical): capacity and petrochemistry by central priority lists; price: consumer goods +5 %, FDGB -5.

e: The Planned Economy: Production line change efficiency +5 %
foci.d: Georg Klaus's cybernetics and the new Robotron combine promise a plan that calculates itself. Ulbricht orders an automated control system for the whole economy by 1975 - and computing centres for the Planning Commission.
foci.o: Flagship project of the doctrine branch.

foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Walter Ulbricht is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_ulb`); date from 01.06.1970

foci.d: 19 March 1970: Willy Brandt comes to Erfurt. Ulbricht sends Stoph with one demand - recognition under international law - while the crowd outside the Erfurter Hof chants 'Willy, Willy' - until the MfS fills the square with its own people.

foci.b: `has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_ger_the_kassel_meeting` (the Kassel meeting - no double reward)
e: The Party State: Ideological defence (Cold War) +3 %
foci.d: 21 May 1970: in Kassel Brandt offers twenty points for regulated coexistence. Stoph answers with one - recognition first. Ulbricht's republic negotiates as a sovereign state or not at all.

e: Programme "The Founder's Course": Licence production speed +3 %
foci.d: Summer 1970, before Brezhnev: 'We are not Belorussia, we are not a Soviet republic.' Ulbricht lectures the Kremlin on economics and keeps his own channel to Bonn for credits, licences and trade.
foci.o: Moscow vs Bonn: Western trade, money and a happy Kombinat lobby; price: Moscow's Trust -5.

foci.d: Ulbricht swallows his pride: the German policy is coordinated with Moscow line by line, the economic theses go to Gosplan before they go to the Central Committee - and the Soviet oil keeps flowing.
foci.o: Moscow vs Bonn: Moscow's favour, Soviet science and oil; price: the reformers lose ground (Kombinat Directors -5).

foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Walter Ulbricht is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_ulb`); date from 21.01.1971
e: Event: Ambassador Abrasimov delivers Brezhnev's displeasure; the signatories of the letter must recant or lose their posts
Ulbricht defies the letter (`COLDWAR_DDR_ulb_stays`): the resignation event of 3 May 1971 does not fire while he is First Secretary
Adds "The Founder Defiant" for 1095 days: Political power gain +10 %, Stability -3 %
Programme "The Founder's Course": Productivity growth +3 %, Civilian factory output +3 %
foci.d: Alt-history: 21 January 1971 - thirteen Politburo members have asked Brezhnev, behind Ulbricht's back, to let the old man go. Ulbricht refuses. He convenes the Central Committee himself, invokes forty years at the head of the party and dares Brezhnev to depose the founder of the republic.
foci.o: Alt-hist, player only. Takes over the old hub "Thirteen Signatures". Moscow's Trust -10 pushes the start value (48) into 'Moscow's Displeasure'. Reward: Ulbricht stays (flag) and his reform continues; price: Moscow, the Nomenklatura, unrest.

foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Walter Ulbricht is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_ulb`); date from 21.01.1971
e: Ulbricht announces his retirement (`COLDWAR_DDR_ulb_retiring`): once an heir is designated below, the Central Committee is convened for him without support conditions; Ulbricht's programme ends with the change
foci.d: 3 May 1971, after the letter of the thirteen: 'for reasons of age'. Ulbricht hands over the party and keeps the chair of the State Council - the founder leaves with ceremony, not in disgrace. His reformers lose their patron.
foci.o: Historical. Choose the heir and finish the capstones first - the change of leader closes this tree.

e: Ulbricht's death event moves from 1 August 1973 to 1 August 1976 (`COLDWAR_DDR_ulb_kremlin_doctors`)
Event: Spring 1973: a heart attack - the doctors save him, but the old man must rest at Lake Döllnsee
foci.d: Alt-history: Professor Chazov's specialists from Moscow and the government hospital in Berlin-Buch keep the old man at his desk - at the price of half-days and a fortune in Western medicine.
foci.o: The reward is three more years of life (flag); the price 0.5 % of GDP.

foci.d: Whoever follows Ulbricht inherits a republic built in his image. The old man wants to name the heir himself - before Moscow names one for him - and to hand over a party in good order.

e: Designated heir: Erich Honecker takes over on death or retirement
foci.d: The pupil inherits the master's chair: Moscow's favourite and the party's organiser, who promises the people more today.

e: Designated heir: Willi Stoph takes over on death or retirement

foci.d: The premier of Erfurt and Kassel: the state administration over the party apparatus.

foci.d: Alt-history: the youngest star of the Politburo, forty-one, the only leader the young like - the old guard is appalled.

foci.n: The Developed Social System of Socialism
foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Walter Ulbricht is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_ulb`); "The Polytechnic Generation" completed
e: Adds "The Developed Social System": Stability +4 %, Research speed +3 %, Max factory efficiency +3 %, Stability from party popularity +3 %
Programme "The Founder's Course": Workforce +2 %, Civilian factory output +2 %
foci.d: Ulbricht's grand theory: socialism is no brief transition but a social formation of its own, planned by science and carried by a community - a system that needs no lessons from Moscow.
foci.o: Capstone: needs the party column and the doctrine branch. Brezhnev's ideologists read the thesis as a claim to independence (trust -5).

e: Programme "The Main Task": Political power gain +5 %, Stability +2 %
Our leader gains the trait "Man of the Apparatus"
foci.d: Erich Honecker: born 1912 in Wiebelskirchen, roofer, Communist youth leader, ten years in Nazi prisons, organiser of the 13th of August. Moscow's choice - and a man who wants the people content.

Günter Mittag keeps - or regains - the economic secretariat: a brilliant, feared technocrat who will make the numbers fit whatever the General Secretary promises, and who squeezes the works councils to do it.

e: Programme "The Main Task": Fuel gain +5 %, Licence production speed +3 %
foci.d: Werner Krolikowski, the Dresden district chief, takes the economic secretariat (as from 1973 to 1976) - coordinates every plan figure with Gosplan - Soviet oil and Soviet licences are secured - and reports every number to the Soviet embassy on Unter den Linden. The general directors distrust him.

e: Programme "The Main Task": Economic cycle law costs -1 %
foci.d: Alt-history: Gerhard Schürer, chairman of the State Planning Commission, also gets the economic secretariat - and insists that the plan show what the republic can really afford. The padding goes; so do a few promises.

foci.n: The Unity of Economic and Social Policy
e: The Economic Line becomes "The Unity of Economic and Social Policy": Stability +4 %, Consumer goods -3 %, Monthly population +0.03, Social costs +8 %, Interest rates +5 %
foci.d: June 1971, VIII Party Congress: the 'main task' is to raise the material and cultural standard of living of the people. Every gain in production is paid out at once in rents, pensions, wages, the baby year and goods - the investment race of the Ulbricht years ends, and the import bill starts to grow.
foci.o: Doctrine entry (takes over "The Eighth Party Congress" and "The Social Policy Programme"): replaces whichever economic line is active. The economy section's labour ladder may count this focus as Honecker's natalist step.

foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Erich Honecker is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hon`); date from 01.01.1978
foci.b: `has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_cons_jeans_for_the_youth` (the jeans import of 1978 - no double reward)
foci.d: The state buys 800,000 pairs of Levi's in the West and they sell out within days. Western goods in Eastern shops calm the young - and drain the hard-currency reserves.

e: The Economic Line becomes "Consumption on Credit": Stability +5 %, Consumer goods -4 %, Monthly population +0.03, Interest rates +10 %, World-market exposure (Cold War) +10 %
Western credit: treasury +1.5 % of GDP, debt +1.5 % of GDP
foci.d: 1972-80: the social programme is paid with Western credit - the hard-currency debt rises from 2 to 25 billion valuta marks. The shops are full, the interest bill grows, and Moscow watches the republic drift into the world market.
foci.o: Model fork A1 (historical): stability and goods now; price: interest +10 %, world-market exposure, debt, Moscow's Trust -3.

e: The Economic Line becomes "Consumption from Accumulation": Stability +3 %, Consumer goods -3 %, Social costs +5 %, Interest rates -5 %, Civilian factory construction -10 %
foci.d: Alt-history: Schürer's advice is taken in 1972 - the social programme is paid by cutting industrial investment, not by borrowing. Fewer new factories, more new flats, and no debt to the bankers of Frankfurt.
foci.o: Model fork A2: no debt, lower interest, Moscow approves; price: factory construction -10 %, Kombinat Directors -5.

foci.d: October 1973: 'to solve the housing question as a social problem by 1990'. Three million flats are to be built or modernised - prefabricated estates from Marzahn to Halle-Neustadt, the WBS 70 slab.
foci.o: Flagship project. The yearly building drives (decisions) belong to the economy section's housing branch.

foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Erich Honecker is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hon`); date from 01.01.1979
e: Western credit: treasury +1 % of GDP, debt +1 % of GDP
foci.d: The second oil shock and Western interest rates strike in 1979-80, but the subsidies stay: bread at 1950s prices, frozen rents, coffee bought for hard currency. The new credits pay for the old ones.
foci.o: Short/long fork B1 (historical): stability now; price: debt, interest +5 %.

foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Erich Honecker is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hon`); date from 01.01.1979
foci.d: Alt-history: Honecker listens to Schürer's warning. Subsidies for luxury goods are cut, imports frozen, and the party tells the people the truth: the republic lives beyond its means.
foci.o: Short/long fork B2: solvency and revenue; price: stability -3 %, FDGB -5.

e: Programme "The Main Task": Infrastructure construction +5 %, Workforce +2 %
foci.d: April 1986, XI Party Congress: the housing programme is on schedule, the birth rate is up, full employment holds. Honecker declares the main task a success - and promises more of the same.
foci.o: Capstone of the doctrine branch.

e: The Party State: Ideological defence (Cold War) +3 %, Foreign influence defence +5 %
Recognition and the UN seat are won in "The Struggle for Recognition" (foreign policy); this focus rewrites the doctrine
foci.d: From 1971 the answer to Brandt's Ostpolitik is Abgrenzung: contacts with Westerners are reported, Western television is frowned upon, and in 1974 the constitution deletes the 'German nation' - the GDR is a socialist nation of its own, while millions still feel simply German.
foci.o: Takes over "Two Nations" (the 1974 constitution).

foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Erich Honecker is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hon`); date from 01.01.1980
foci.d: 13 October 1980, Gera: Honecker demands that Bonn recognise GDR citizenship and fix the Elbe border in mid-river. Days before, the minimum exchange for Western visitors was doubled to 25 DM - hard currency in, relatives out.

foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Erich Honecker is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hon`); date from 01.01.1982
e: Offer to GER (they decide; no advance reward): A bank credit of one billion DM guaranteed by the federal government. If they accept: Western credit for us (treasury +2 % of GDP, debt +2 % of GDP), Inner-German course +0.10 and Moscow's Trust -3; the automatic firing devices on the border are dismantled
The Planned Economy: Max factory efficiency +3 %
foci.d: 1983: the republic is close to insolvency. Schalck-Golodkowski and Franz Josef Strauss, the arch-anticommunist, arrange a one-billion-DM bank credit guaranteed by Bonn. The border mines begin to disappear.
foci.o: Multiplayer rule: the credit is paid only if West Germany accepts the offer. Our own side: Western machines on the old credit lines, the Kombinat lobby and calm (the review layer adds Moscow's Trust -5).

foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Erich Honecker is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hon`); date from 01.01.1984
e: Offer to GER (they decide; no advance reward): A state visit with full honours. If they accept: stability +5 % and Inner-German course +0.10 for us, and both governments gain opinion of each other (+20)
foci.d: September 1987: Honecker in Bonn - his flag next to the black-red-gold, the anthem, a guard of honour, then a visit to his home town in the Saarland. Recognition in all but name.
foci.o: Moscow blocked the visit in 1984; it took place in 1987. The trust cost is paid on sending the request.

foci.n: Socialism in the Colours of the GDR
foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Erich Honecker is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hon`); date from 11.03.1985
e: The Party State: Ideological defence (Cold War) +5 %
foci.d: December 1988: Honecker answers perestroika with 'socialism in the colours of the GDR'. The Soviet digest Sputnik is banned, Soviet films are pulled - the pupil now lectures Moscow and prepares for a winter without Soviet help.
foci.o: Moscow line fork (historical): the apparatus and the MfS close ranks, self-reliance; price: Moscow's Trust -10.

foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Erich Honecker is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hon`); date from 11.03.1985
e: Programme "The Main Task": Factory efficiency growth +3 %
foci.d: Alt-history: 'To learn from the Soviet Union is to learn victory' - Honecker takes the old slogan at its word, allows openness in the press, lets Sputnik be read and copies the Soviet law on state enterprises.
foci.o: Moscow line fork: Soviet science, enterprise reform, a cleaner party; price: stability -3 % (glasnost bites).

foci.d: The General Secretary is old, ill and convinced he is indispensable. Behind him Krenz, Stoph and Mittag wait - each with his own friends in Moscow. Honecker wants his heir to keep the social programme.

foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Erich Honecker is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hon`); Egon Krenz is alive and not First Secretary; date from 22.05.1976
e: Designated heir: Egon Krenz takes over on death or retirement
foci.d: The FDJ chief and security secretary, born 1937: the crown prince of the second generation.

e: Designated heir: Willi Stoph takes over on death or retirement
Programme "The Main Task": Economic cycle law costs -1 %
foci.d: The old premier, who has reported to Moscow behind Honecker's back for years, as a caretaker.

foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Erich Honecker is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hon`); Günter Mittag is alive and not First Secretary
e: Designated heir: Günter Mittag takes over on death or retirement
Programme "The Main Task": Max factory efficiency +2 %
foci.d: Alt-history: Honecker's closest ally, the economic czar, inherits the party - and its debts.

December 1971: 'If one starts from the firm position of socialism, there can be no taboos in art and literature.' Plenzdorf's 'New Sorrows of Young W.' fills the theatres, and the churches breathe a little easier.
April 1976: on the site of the Hohenzollern palace rises the Palace of the Republic - parliament, theatre, bowling alley and a thousand lamps. Berliners call it 'Erich's lamp shop'.

foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Erich Honecker is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hon`); date from 01.01.1976
e: The Party State: Ideological defence (Cold War) +5 %
foci.d: 16 November 1976: after a concert in Cologne the singer Wolf Biermann is stripped of his citizenship. A hundred artists protest; many follow him west. The thaw is over.
foci.o: Hard vs soft (historical): ideology, the MfS and Moscow pleased; price: stability -2 % (the artists' exodus).

foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Erich Honecker is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hon`); date from 01.01.1976
foci.d: Alt-history: the Politburo lets the troublesome singer come home from Cologne. The artists stay, the churches and the young are reassured, the West German press is baffled - and the Stasi fumes.
foci.o: Hard vs soft: stability, popularity, the church; price: MfS -5, Moscow's Trust -2.

foci.d: 6 March 1978: Honecker receives Bishop Schönherr. The church gets broadcasting time, new church buildings and access to prisons; the state gets a church that works 'in socialism' rather than against it.

e: Shield and Sword: Encryption +10 %, Decryption +5 %, Police costs +5 %
foci.d: Under Honecker the Ministry for State Security doubles to 91,000 officers and some 170,000 informers. Directive 1/76 replaces open terror with quiet Zersetzung - and the bill for it grows every year.

foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Erich Honecker is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hon`); "Socialism in the Colours of the GDR" or "Learning from the Soviet Union" completed
e: Adds "Really Existing Socialism": Stability +5 %, Stability from party popularity +3 %, Consumer goods +3 %, Max factory efficiency -3 %
Programme "The Main Task": Civilian factory output +3 %
foci.d: The republic at forty: new housing estates, full employment, cheap bread, more Olympic medals than the Americans in Seoul - and a hard-currency debt the Planning Commission no longer dares to print. Honecker's socialism exists, really.
foci.o: Capstone: needs the doctrine branch and the Gorbachev fork. No political power: the price is in the idea (consumer goods, efficiency).

e: Programme "The Premier's Course": Political power gain +5 %, Economic cycle law costs -1 %
Our leader gains the trait "The Administrator"
foci.d: Willi Stoph: bricklayer, Wehrmacht artilleryman, first Minister of National Defence, Chairman of the Council of Ministers - the man who shook Brandt's hand in Erfurt now leads the party.
foci.o: Alt-hist leader (candidacy in the Central Committee).

foci.d: Horst Sindermann, the Halle district chief who built Halle-Neustadt, takes over the Council of Ministers (as he did in 1973): a calm administrator with a soft spot for housing and social policy - and little patience for the Kombinat barons.
Alt-history: Gerhard Schürer leaves the Planning Commission for the premiership. The government is run like a balance sheet - and the balance sheet is honest, even when the news is bad.

Alt-history: Stoph keeps the Council of Ministers for himself. Party and government meet in one office - and in one overworked man; the Central Committee secretaries lose their posts in the ministries.
foci.o: The priced PP side of the tree (SED Nomenklatura -5).

e: The Economic Line becomes "Administrative Central Planning": Bureaucracy costs -5 %, Economic cycle law costs -5 %, Max factory efficiency +2 %, Productivity growth -2 %, Research speed -2 %
Programme "The Premier's Course": Factory efficiency growth +3 %
foci.d: The Council of Ministers takes back what the Politburo apparatus took: ministers decide, the Central Committee departments advise, and the plan is run by the state. Stoph has waited twenty years for this.
foci.o: Doctrine entry: replaces whichever economic line is active.

e: The Economic Line becomes "Rule of the Industrial Ministries": Economic cycle law costs -10 %, Civilian factory construction +5 %, Civilian factory output +3 %, Stability +2 %, Bureaucracy costs +5 %
foci.d: The branch ministries give orders to every Kombinat: one ministry for chemistry, one for electrical engineering, one for coal. Order and capacity - and a bureaucracy that grows with every new department.
foci.o: Model fork A1: capacity, order, cheap economic laws; price: bureaucracy +5 %, Kombinat Directors -5.

e: The Economic Line becomes "Prices That Tell the Truth": Civilian industry tax +5 %, Tax revenue +3 %, Consumer goods -2 %, Stability -3 %
Programme "The Premier's Course": Civilian factory productivity +3 %
foci.d: The industrial price reform of 1964-67 is carried on to consumer prices: goods are recalculated from real costs, subsidies stay only for bread and rents - the factories finally see what their goods cost, and the people see it too.
foci.o: Model fork A2: revenue and efficiency; price: stability -2 % now and -3 % in the doctrine, FDGB -5.

e: Programme "The Premier's Course": Economic cycle law costs -2 %
foci.d: Fewer forms, computing centres in every ministry, ESER mainframes for the State Planning Commission: Stoph cuts the state apparatus by a tenth and makes the rest count.
foci.o: Flagship project.

e: The Planned Economy: Licence production speed +5 %
foci.d: The plan is tied to deliveries from West Germany: steel, machines and chemicals bought on the interest-free swing of inner-German trade, paid back in goods. Moscow asks why the Five-Year Plan reads like a West German order book.
foci.o: Short/long fork B1: hard currency and West German machines and licences now; price: Moscow's Trust -3.

foci.d: From 1971 the Five-Year Plans are coordinated line by line with Moscow under the Comecon Comprehensive Programme: secure oil and gas for twenty years, Soviet science - and less room for the general directors.
foci.o: Short/long fork B2: Moscow's favour, research sharing and fuel; price: Kombinat Directors -5, less Western trade.

e: Programme "The Premier's Course": Max factory efficiency +3 %, Economic cycle law costs -2 %
foci.d: The Council of Ministers' own Five-Year Plan: drawn up by the ministries, checked by the Planning Commission, approved by the Volkskammer - and only then shown to the Politburo.
foci.o: Capstone of the doctrine branch.

e: Offer to GER (they decide; no advance reward): A permanent channel between the two heads of government. If they accept: both governments gain opinion of each other (+15) and the Inner-German course moves +0.05
foci.d: Stoph and Brandt met in Erfurt and Kassel in 1970. As First Secretary, Stoph keeps the personal line to Bonn open and writes to the Chancellor as one head of government to another - correct, cool, always with the full title of the German Democratic Republic.
foci.o: Takes over "Premier to Chancellor".

foci.d: Alt-history: Stoph offers neighbourly relations without demarcation - travel relief, town twinning, joint work against the poisoned Elbe - as one sovereign state to another. Inner-German trade booms; Moscow frowns.
foci.o: Bonn line: trade income, stability, the church; price: Moscow's Trust -5.

e: The Party State: Ideological defence (Cold War) +5 %, Sanction resistance (Imperia) +5 %
foci.d: Stoph's other answer: every contact codified, every border post fixed by treaty, every Western visitor counted. Coexistence on paper, separation in practice - and the churches lose their West German partners.
foci.o: Moscow line: Moscow's Trust, security, self-reliance; price: Protestant Church -5 (the review layer adds trade opinion -3 %, so this focus keeps to one dynamic modifier).

e: The National People's Army: Army personnel costs -3 %, Training time -5 %
foci.d: Stoph built the National People's Army in 1956 and still holds the rank of Army General. The officers know him - and he knows what they cost.

e: The National People's Army: Mobilisation speed +5 %
foci.d: As First Secretary Stoph chairs the National Defence Council, the republic's secret war cabinet, and rebuilds it around the ministries: mobilisation plans for every district, paid from the civilian budget.
foci.o: Guns: readiness and the officers' favour; price: 0.3 % of GDP.

e: The National People's Army: Equipment costs -3 %
foci.d: The administrator turns on his old ministry: the army's budget is audited line by line, and the savings go to the Council of Ministers' investment fund.
foci.o: Butter: money and a factory; price: NVA Command -5.

foci.a: `emerging_communist_state_are_in_power`; Willi Stoph is First Secretary (`COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_sto`); "The Government Plans" completed
e: Adds "A State Like Any Other": Bureaucracy costs -10 %, Trade opinion +10 %, Stability +3 %, Political power gain -5 %
foci.d: Stoph's republic: governed by ministries, administered by experts, recognised by its neighbours - a state like any other, not merely the party's instrument. The party notices that it has become less important.
foci.o: Capstone: needs the doctrine branch and the German fork. Price: the party loses political power to the state (idea) and the Nomenklatura's goodwill.

e: Programme "The Premier's Course": Max factory efficiency +2 %
foci.d: Stoph was born in 1914. His heir should be a man of the state, not of the apparatus - and the ministries should keep running while the Central Committee decides.

foci.d: Stoph's ally in the Politburo and Moscow's informant: the Kremlin will approve, and the oil will keep flowing.

foci.n: The Master of the Balance Sheet
e: Programme "The Technocrat's Course": Productivity growth +3 %, Max factory efficiency +2 %
Our leader gains the trait "Economic Czar"
foci.d: Günter Mittag: co-author of the New Economic System, secretary for the economy, the most feared man in the Politburo's corridors. Now he answers to nobody but the balance sheet.
foci.o: Alt-hist leader (candidacy in the Central Committee).

e: Programme "The Technocrat's Course": Economic cycle law costs -1 %
foci.d: Gerhard Schürer stays at the State Planning Commission - the one man who dares to put the real debt figures on Mittag's desk. The general directors hate his honest balance.

e: Programme "The Technocrat's Course": Arms market income +5 %
foci.d: Alexander Schalck-Golodkowski's Commercial Coordination answers to Mittag directly: arms, art, blood plasma and prisoners for hard currency, no questions asked - and no receipts.

e: The Planned Economy: Civilian factory output +3 %
foci.d: Wolfgang Biermann runs Carl Zeiss Jena like a feudal estate and delivers every plan. Mittag makes him the model for all general directors - results first, workers' councils last.

e: The Economic Line becomes "Key Technologies": Research speed +3 %, microchip_plant_productivity_modifier +5 %, Civilian factory productivity +3 %, Consumer goods +3 %, Stability -2 %
foci.d: Mittag turns Ulbricht's prestige race into a short list: microelectronics, robotics, computer-aided design, biotechnology. Everything else waits - including the shops.
foci.o: Doctrine entry: replaces whichever economic line is active (coexists historically with Honecker's social policy, 1976-89).

e: The Planned Economy: Energy use -5 %, Productivity growth +3 %
foci.d: 'Comprehensive intensification' after the Soviet oil cut of 1981: more output from the same machines, the same energy and the same people. Every Kombinat must save energy and materials every year.

e: The Economic Line becomes "Export at Any Price": Resource export revenue +8 %, Civilian industry tax +5 %, Trade opinion +5 %, Consumer goods +5 %, World-market exposure (Cold War) +10 %
foci.d: From 1982 whatever earns hard currency is exported: furniture for Swedish catalogues, cameras for West German mail-order houses, petrol refined at Schwedt from Soviet crude - even blood plasma. The shops at home stay empty; Moscow notices the oil.
foci.o: Model fork A1 (takes over "Selling the Oil"): hard currency now; price: consumer goods +5 %, world-market exposure, stability -2 %, FDGB -5, Moscow's Trust -2.

e: The Economic Line becomes "Modernisation on Credit": Max factory efficiency +5 %, Licence production speed +10 %, Research speed +2 %, Interest rates +10 %
Western credit: treasury +2 % of GDP, debt +2 % of GDP
foci.d: Mittag borrows in the West to modernise for export - the credits will be repaid by the goods the new plants make. In 1981 the banks stop lending; not every plant is finished.
foci.o: Model fork A2 (the 1970s model): modern plants and licences; price: interest +10 %, debt, Moscow's Trust -3.

e: The Planned Economy: Max factory efficiency +3 %
Western credit: treasury +0.5 % of GDP, debt +0.5 % of GDP
foci.d: Rolling mills, chemical plants and assembly lines from West Germany, France and Japan, Volkswagen engines for the Wartburg: the West builds, the republic pays in goods and credit.
foci.o: Takes over "Licences from the West". The review layer adds Moscow's Trust -2.

foci.b: `has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_micro_the_microelectronics_decision` (the microelectronics programme of 1977 - no double reward)
e: The Planned Economy: microchip_plant_productivity_modifier +5 %, Consumer goods +2 %
foci.d: June 1977: the Politburo decides that the republic will make its own chips. Erfurt and Dresden get the money, ZMD gets the best engineers - and the consumer goods plan gets what is left.
foci.o: Flagship project.

foci.b: `has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_mfs_sector_science_and_technology` (the MfS technology sector - no double reward)
foci.d: The foreign intelligence service's science and technology sector steals what COCOM will not sell: IBM software, chip masks, Western patents by the suitcase.

foci.b: `has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_the_kombinat_reform` (the Kombinat reform of 1979 - no double reward)
e: Programme "The Technocrat's Course": Max factory efficiency +3 %
The Planned Economy: Civilian factory output +3 %
foci.d: 1979-80: almost all industry is folded into some 130 centrally run Kombinate, each with its own research, suppliers and export trade - every Kombinat makes its own screws, on the Carl Zeiss model. The general directors report straight to Mittag; the last semi-state suppliers are swallowed.
foci.o: Short/long fork B1 (historical; takes over "The General Directors"): capacity, the directors happy; price: craftsmen -10.

e: Programme "The Technocrat's Course": Civilian factory productivity +3 %
The Planned Economy: Civilian factory construction +5 %
foci.d: Alt-history: the Kombinate stay lean - the semi-state suppliers keep their workshops and sell parts to the Kombinate by contract. The general directors lose their empires.
foci.o: Short/long fork B2: productivity and faster factory building, craftsmen +10; price: Kombinat Directors -5.

foci.d: Industrial robots by the tens of thousands - many of them home-made, many of them idle - are meant to replace the workers the republic does not have.
foci.o: The economy section's "The Labour Shortage" ladder may count this focus as the automation step (has_completed_focus).

e: Adds "The Kombinat Republic": Factory efficiency growth +5 %, Civilian factory output +3 %, Political power gain -5 %
Programme "The Technocrat's Course": Tax revenue +3 %, microchip_plant_productivity_modifier +5 %
foci.d: Mittag's republic: one great enterprise of Kombinate and chip works from Erfurt to Dresden, run from one office by numbers - brilliant at the Leipzig fair, efficient on paper, and answerable to no one. The party loses power to the general directors.
foci.o: Capstone of the doctrine branch (takes over "The Microchip Works"). Price: political power -5 % in the idea.

e: Programme "The Technocrat's Course": Economic cycle law costs -1 %
foci.d: Alt-history: the Politburo's Economic Commission under Mittag becomes the real government. The Central Committee departments are bypassed, the general directors sit at the table - and the Nomenklatura is told what has been decided.
foci.o: Technocracy: cheap administration and economic laws, the directors' loyalty; price: SED Nomenklatura -10.

e: The Party State: Ideological defence (Cold War) +5 %
foci.d: Mittag has no friends in the Politburo, only debtors - so he buys some: villas in Wandlitz, Volvos, Intershop allowances and hunting lodges for the district chiefs. The apparatus is loyal, and it knows its price.
foci.o: Apparatus: a loyal, disciplined party; price: corruption +1 level.

foci.d: The successor must be someone the apparatus will accept and the Kombinate will obey - and someone who will not open the books too quickly.
